purpose_context: This is wave-1 mission M1 of the muster <-> spec-kitty agent-conformance programme. It bootstraps a conformance/ tree in the spec-kitty fork containing a muster skills manifest covering all 53 built-in skills, a rigged control case that proves the suite can fail, the programme's D1-D5 decision record, and a PR-gating GitHub Actions workflow that runs muster via muster-action@v1 fully offline. It makes zero changes to muster itself and proves the muster<->spec-kitty integration seam end to end, unblocking three later spec-kitty-side conformance missions (M3, M6, M7).
purpose_tldr: Wire spec-kitty's 53 built-in SKILL.md files through muster's static skills adapter and gate every PR on the result.
